{{Quote|Now, Viceroy, we will discuss a new treaty!|Queen Amidala captures Viceroy Nute Gunray|audio=ANewTreaty-TPM.flac|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The term '''viceroy''' could apply to a variety of governing positions, often in place of a monarch or in control of a large jurisdiction.

During the [[Golden Age of the Sith]], the title of viceroy was held by certain individuals in the [[Sith Empire/Legends|old Sith Empire]] who ruled as the presiding [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] of their respective fief worlds. Prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] ruled as viceroy of [[Khar Shian]],<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the sole moon of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] sacred world of [[Khar Delba]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The leader of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation of Planets]] held the title of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]], such as the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo Crisis]] up until [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|death]] alongside other members of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatise Council]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

Viceroy was also one of the titles, the other being [[First Chairman/Legends|First Chairman]], held by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[House of Organa/Legends|royal house of Organa]] during the Clone Wars and the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] until Alderaan's [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] of [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]&ndash;[[17 BBY/Legends|17 ABY]], the ''[[Darama]]'' was leader of the [[Yevetha]] and [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the [[Duskhan League]], and generally assumed the status of viceroy of the League.
